blocks.en: A Hilbert space (or, more generally, a Banach space) is called \textbf{separable} if it contains a countable, dense subset.
blocks.zh: 若 Hilbert 空间 (或更一般地, Banach 空间) 含有可数稠密子集, 则称其\textbf{可分}.
blocks.label: def:separable-space

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Most spaces arising in applications are separable. Separability is important for the practical solution of problems, say, by discretization, because only countably many (well, in the real world, only finitely many) elements of the space can be represented in such a fashion. It is easy to see that $\ell^2$ is separable, because terminating sequences are dense. The space $L^2(\Omega)$ is also separable; see Problem~\ref{ex:lp-two-separable}.
blocks.zh: 应用中出现的大多数空间都是可分的. 可分性对于例如通过离散化实际求解问题十分重要, 因为用这种方式只能表示空间中可数多个 (实际上, 现实世界中只有有限多个) 元素. 容易看出 $\ell^2$ 可分, 因为终止序列稠密. 空间 $L^2(\Omega)$ 也可分; 见 Problem~\ref{ex:lp-two-separable}.

blocks.label: def:hilbert-orthogonal-complement

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It is clear that $M^\perp$ is a closed subspace. If $M$ is also closed, then $H$ is the direct sum of $M$ and $M^\perp$: $H=M\oplus M^\perp$.
blocks.zh: 显然 $M^\perp$ 是闭子空间. 若 $M$ 也闭, 则 $H$ 为 $M$ 与 $M^\perp$ 的直和: $H=M\oplus M^\perp$.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $H$ be a Hilbert space and let $M$ be a closed subspace of $H$. Then every $u\in H$ has a unique decomposition $u=v+w$, where $v\in M$ and $w\in M^\perp$.
blocks.zh: 设 $H$ 为 Hilbert 空间, $M$ 为 $H$ 的闭子空间. 那么每个 $u\in H$ 都具有唯一分解 $u=v+w$, 其中 $v\in M$ 且 $w\in M^\perp$.
blocks.label: thm:hilbert-orthogonal-projection

blocks.en: Let $H$ be a Hilbert space. A subspace $M$ of $H$ is dense iff $M^\perp=\{0\}$.
blocks.zh: 设 $H$ 为 Hilbert 空间. $H$ 的子空间 $M$ 稠密的充分必要条件为 $M^\perp=\{0\}$.
blocks.label: cor:hilbert-density-orthogonal-complement

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
Suppose $v\in M^\perp$. Then $(v,u)=0$ for every $u\in M$. If $M$ is dense, we conclude that $(v,u)=0$ for every $u\in H$ by taking limits. Setting $u=v$ yields $v=0$.

On the other hand, the closure of $M$ has an orthogonal complement according to the preceding theorem. If $M$ is not dense, then this orthogonal complement must contain nonzero vectors.
blocks.zh:
设 $v\in M^\perp$. 那么对每个 $u\in M$ 有 $(v,u)=0$. 若 $M$ 稠密, 则取极限可得对每个 $u\in H$ 有 $(v,u)=0$. 令 $u=v$ 得到 $v=0$.

另一方面, 由前一定理, $M$ 的闭包具有正交补. 若 $M$ 不稠密, 则这一正交补必含非零向量.
